description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'HolidayService' class within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class provides methods to manage holidays, including searching, caching, and checking if specific dates are holidays or half-days.

classes.name: HolidayService
classes.description: Service class providing holiday management functionalities, such as searching holidays with caching, checking if a date is a holiday or half-day, and deleting holidays.

methods.name: getHolidayDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the HolidayDao instance used for database operations related to holidays.

methods.name: saveHoliday
methods.description: Saves a holiday entity and clears the relevant cache.

methods.name: getHolidaysCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key string based on date range for holiday cache.

methods.name: searchHolidays
methods.description: Searches for holidays within a date range with optional pagination.

methods.name: searchHolidaysCount
methods.description: Returns the count of holidays within a date range.

methods.name: searchHolidaysAlongWithCache
methods.description: Handles the caching logic for holiday search results.

methods.name: getCalculatedHolidays
methods.description: Calculates the holiday list within a date range, handling recurring holidays and sorting.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a specific date is a full-day holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if a specific date is a half-day holiday based on holiday length and configuration.

methods.name: isHalfDayHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a specific date is a designated half-day holiday.

methods.name: deleteHolidays
methods.description: Deletes multiple holidays by their IDs and clears cache.
